{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Remove commas from revenue strings and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.replace('$', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_revenue_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue'].idxmax()]['channel']

# Print the result
max_revenue_channel"}
